text: [laughing] Two down in four minutes. I was still queuing for my pie!
Four-four with Villa, and United are in the bottom three. One question. Stick with Carrick... or twist?
[angry, fast] First manager in forty years to take us into the bottom three. He's had his chance. Change it!
[passionate, raised voice] He's one of our own, mate! Third last season. These players let him down, not the other way round.
[tired, quiet] Thirty goals conceded already. [sighs] That's coaching, that is.
[calm, firm] Neither. Listen to the Stretford End. The problem's the owners, not the man in the dugout.
